column1: # Every RS30 family model (one list, the same X50Projector calls on every RS30 stock), since the RS30 Ultra Max
# (g0155, 2026-11-12): the X50 Ultra's per-app exceptions as they are, kept equal to
# devices/g0111/research/unbanned_x50projector.tsv row for row (the same app and the same stock behaviour). This stock
# sends the same calls with the same values (newsettings v1.1.42, decompiled on xgimi-builder
# setLowConfigureKeyStoneValue(50) and setTiltShiftMove(13, 0f) in the keystone reset; tree nodes reset_keystone,
# zoom_and_optical_shift. Format and rules: the g0111 file. rs30-parity-projection: the lens memory rows 107-110 are
# here only because this model runs the same APK; the RS30 tree has no lens_memory node and Gmpf refuses the calls on
# it (ModelMenu.RS30 does not name zoom.memory). Its AgileWall app sends the same four calls with the same vendor code.

column6: stock setLowConfigureKeyStoneValue(50) of the keystone reset (newsettings KeyStoneManager.resetKeyStone 286-334)
the stock lens shift page (TiltShiftLensViewModel 152-243, held key = move, UP = stop 5) and the reset's shift home (13, 0f)
the stock auto focus after an optical zoom change (ZoomStateView.release -> KeyStoneManager.autoFocus = autoFocus((byte) 47))

the RS30 pan-tilt head on the screen displacement page (newsettings PtzViewModel: 6 up, 7 down, 3 left, 4 right at the edge, 8 / 5 the stop on the key UP, always 0f; G0155 feature.xml support_pantilt_type 1); the X50 has no head (stock X50 support_pantilt_type 0): the app refuses it there, the row exists because the RS30 runs the same APK

the stock lens memory save, DataRepository.createNimbleOpticalPos(id, {id, name}): libxgimi Msrv_DataBase_Manage_Mtk.setNimbleOptCriMemory = Env_DataBase setEnv(nimble_opt_cri_memory) + saveEnv, no calibration key
the stock lens memory rename (rename_only) and save again (update_all), DataRepository.updateNimbleOpticalPos: Env keys nimble_opt_cri_memory and nimble_opt_current_pos_id only
the stock lens memory delete, DataRepository.deleteNimbleOpticalPos: the same two Env keys

the stock lens memory (newsettings DataRepository.executeNimbleOpticalPos): the vendor moves zoom and lens shift back with its own motor control and puts back the keystone, light level and iris it stored with them

the stock sleep's vendor step (services.jar PowerManagerService.xgimiPrepareSleep -> XgimiSmsController.gotoSleep(0, 0), G0111 1.3.38, G0082, G0148): standby stage 1, the vendor sleep before the kernel's, gmpf_wake_lock released; (4, 2) = the stock light standby (XgimiWindowManagerDomestic SleepThread) when needGotoSleep holds (PJLink, the serial control with console type 2, boot mode); never mode 1 or the power HAL's (2, 1)
the end of the stock light standby (XgimiWindowManagerDomestic SleepThread -> XgimiSmsController.wakeUp(2), G0111 1.3.38), only after this app sent goToSleep(4, 2)
